page.overview:
Who is Carsta Scheidt?

Carsta was a baker's daughter and looking forward to continuing in her parents' footsteps when the Skaven invaded. They baked her father in his own oven. Carsta has managed to ingratiate herself with a large number of Skaven by being a submissive slave and skilled cook. Rare amongst resistance members, it was Carsta who contacted the Resistance rather than the other way around and started passing them whatever information she had overheard. The Ratmen deem her a model slave. She manages to keep a pleasant smile on her face by constantly imagining what will happen to all her customers the day the Resistance lets her lace a huge batch of bread and pastries with poison.
